history.titleZh: 参议院调查称部分AI数据中心的说法具有误导性
history.descriptionZh:
美国参议院一项为期一年的AI数据中心调查发现，一些开发商在项目给社区带来的成本与收益上误导公众。据Time报道，开发商通常大力宣传项目建设期创造的建筑岗位，却拒绝披露数据中心投入运营后能带来多少永久岗位。少数给出数据的公司显示：每1兆瓦容量仅对应约1个永久职位。也就是说，一个100兆瓦的数据中心——耗电量约相当于10万户家庭——只会雇用约100人。按此比例推算，1吉瓦项目也仅约1000个永久岗位。参议员Elizabeth Warren表示，国会必须问责大型科技公司，让它们支付公平份额；参议员Chris Van Hollen也指出，报告揭示了美国工薪阶层和地方社区正在为大型科技公司数据中心的巨大扩张买单，而这些公司却继续在缺乏透明度的情况下运营。

从技术与经济机制看，AI数据中心以大量GPU服务器为核心，训练和推理带来极高功耗，且需要冷却、变电和输电等配套基础设施。本次调查的核心并非芯片或算法创新，而是AI基础设施扩张中的成本转移与政策套利问题。调查除就业外，还审查了地方和州政府给予数据中心的税收优惠。申请阶段，房产税减免往往更引人关注，但针对计算机设备的销售税豁免实际上更有利，因为数据中心会持续维护、更换和升级硬件。报告估计，1吉瓦数据中心支出的39%用于昂贵GPU。如果这些项目未兑现就业和经济收益承诺，州政府将损失大量税收收入。

被调查公司包括Amazon、Google、Meta、Microsoft、CoreWeave、Digital Realty和Equinix。它们不愿承担服务数据中心所需的额外基础设施成本，尽管此前曾承诺“自付其路”。这些公司表示愿意支付直接成本，但认为不应为可能惠及其它用户的大型投资负责，例如新建发电厂和输电线路；然而这些投资主要由其电力需求驱动。今年早些时候，数据中心开发商签署的“费率payer保护承诺”曾试图立法，但因参议员认为其“没有牙齿”而失败。此次调查表明，国会并未放弃，而是对AI背后的基础设施展开更广泛监管，尤其针对其巨大电力消耗以及周边居民抗议等问题。相关趋势还包括：美国已有500多个AI数据中心禁令或限制、42个州发生142起抗议，亚马逊还警告680亿美元受阻数据中心威胁美国AI领先地位。整体来看，AI数据中心正从技术扩张问题演变为电力、税收、社区和监管的公共政策冲突；未来项目需要在选址、供电、成本分摊、税收透明和社区收益方面给出更可信承诺，否则可能面临更严格审查和部署阻力。

history.title: We tested gaming performance in 17-year-old Windows 7 on a modern gaming PC against Windows 11
history.description: We managed to install Windows 7 on a modern PC and put it to the test across eight DirectX 11 games and two DirectX 9 titles to see how its gaming performance compares to Windows 11 today.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 20 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter After the rough reception of Windows Vista, Windows 7 launched in 2009 to largely positive reviews. Even 17 years later, it remains one of the most beloved versions of Windows ever released. But how does this nearly two-decade-old operating system hold up on modern hardware? We managed to install Windows 7 on a modern PC and put it to the test across eight DirectX 11 games and two DirectX 9 titles to see how its gaming performance compares to Windows 11 today. Surprisingly, Windows 7 still carves out many notable wins over its successor.At launch, Windows 7 was very similar to Windows Vista in many respects. Vista had introduced significant changes under the hood compared to Windows XP, including technologies such as SuperFetch, ReadyBoost, ReadyDrive, new asynchronous APIs, and other I/O improvements. It also introduced native processor power management and various memory-management enhancements. On the visual side, Vista was the first version of Windows to feature Windows Aero, with its distinctive glass-like window borders.Windows 7 retained many of these underlying technologies while addressing several of Vista’s biggest criticisms. One notable improvement was greater control over User Account Control (UAC), allowing users to adjust how frequently they received UAC prompts. In Vista, these prompts could appear far too often, becoming a major source of frustration for many users.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Windows 7 also benefited from something that had nothing to do with the operating system itself: more powerful hardware. When Vista launched, many mid-range and budget PCs struggled to deliver smooth performance, particularly when using more demanding visual features such as Windows Aero. By 2009, however, PC hardware had advanced considerably, and the performance required to run these features smoothly was no longer a significant concern for most users.The Challenge of Running Windows 7 on a Modern PCGetting Windows 7 running on modern hardware is not as straightforward as installing a current version of Windows. At 17 years old, the operating system predates many of the technologies used by modern PCs, meaning driver support is extremely limited. For example, Windows 7 does not include native NVMe or USB 3.0 support, so the necessary drivers have to be slipstreamed into the installation ISO. Microsoft did eventually release patches that added NVMe support, but without injecting the appropriate drivers into the ISO, the Windows 7 installer will not recognize an NVMe drive. You may like We tested the impact of SSD speed on gaming performance in 11 titles Gears of War: E-Day PC graphics performance tested Gears of War E-Day is an uncharacteristically CPU-heavy Unreal Engine 5 game Our system is based on AMD’s AM5 platform (with the full system specifications detailed later in the article), which presents another limitation: there are no official Windows 7 chipset drivers for the platform.Fortunately, we are using an RDNA 2 GPU, which does have Windows 7 driver support, allowing us to use a relatively modern graphics card for our testing.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe motherboard is also an important consideration. Modern motherboards that have dropped CSM (Compatibility Support Module) and legacy boot support can make installing Windows 7 considerably more difficult, and in some cases may prevent the operating system from booting altogether. Fortunately, our motherboard still supports CSM, so this was not an issue for our setup.Test System (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Windows 7 system specsAMD Radeon RX 6950 XTRyzen 7 9800X3D64GB (2x32GB) G.SKILL Flare X5 DDR5 @6000 MHz CL30Seagate Lightsaber FireCuda (530) NVMe SSDASUS ROG STRIX B850-F Gaming WiFiCorsair Nautilus 360 RS AIO CoolerHAGS not supported by driverWindows 7 Ultimate 64-bit Service Pack 1 (Build 7601)AMD Adrenalin 22.6.1 for Windows 7 (2022)Windows 11 system specsAMD Radeon RX 6950 XTRyzen 7 9800X3D64GB (2x32GB) G.SKILL Flare X5 DDR5 @6000 MHz CL30Seagate Lightsaber FireCuda (530) NVMe SSDASUS ROG STRIX B850-F Gaming WiFiCorsair Nautilus 360 RS AIO CoolerHAGS not supported by driverWindows 11 25H2 (Build 26200.9278)AMD Adrenalin 22.6.1 for Windows 11 (2022)For Windows 7, we disabled Secure Boot, enabled CSM, and set Boot Device Control to Legacy OPROM Only. Enabling CSM means that we no longer have access to Resizable BAR (it's not supported anyway). For Windows 11, we disabled VBS (Virtualization-Based Security) and HVCI (Hypervisor-Protected Code Integrity).It is important to note that while we used Adrenalin 22.6.1 for both Windows 11 and Windows 7 testing, the two packages contain different internal driver versions. Although both packages were released in June 2022, the Windows 11 driver is based on a more advanced codebase than the Windows 7 driver. What to read next Control Resonant PC performance tested Benchmarking 31 different CPUs in Onimusha: Way of the Sword AMD Ryzen 7 7700X3D review: A slower 7800X3D, but not necessarily a cheaper one In both cases, we performed a clean install of each operating system and filled the SSD to about 50-60%.Performance TestingWe tested ten games in total: eight using DirectX 11 and two using DirectX 9. The DirectX 11 titles are the primary focus, as both systems support them natively. By comparison, our Windows 11 system will run DirectX 9 games through the D3D9On12 mapping layer, while our Windows 7 system will run them natively. There are ways to get around the use of D3D9On12 on Windows 11, but we want to evaluate the out-of-the-box experience that most gamers would encounter. As a result, we expect Windows 7 to have an advantage in the DirectX 9 titles.It will become apparent in the results below that the advantages of each operating system will vary depending on whether we are CPU-limited or GPU-limited.Metro 2033 Redux (DX11)Metro 2033 Redux was released in 2014 and features a new lighting engine, higher visual fidelity, and new locations for certain levels. The game is predominantly GPU-bound, but there are moments when GPU utilization drops sharply as you traverse the game world. At these points, the CPU becomes the limiting factor, resulting in a corresponding drop in performance. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Although Windows 11 delivers a higher average frame rate, Windows 7 handles the CPU-related performance drops much better, resulting in significantly stronger 1% lows. Installing the AMD chipset drivers and enabling Resizable BAR improves 1% lows on Windows 11 slightly, but it still falls well behind Windows 7.Windows 11’s more advanced graphics driver appears to provide an advantage in GPU-limited scenarios, while Windows 7’s lower CPU overhead offers more consistent frame pacing, though with lower peak performance.Batman: Arkham Origins (DX11)Batman: Arkham Origins runs on a modified version of Unreal Engine 3 and uses several DX11 enhancements such as Tessellation, Ambient Occlusion HBAO+, Percentage Closer Soft Shadows (PCSS), and Depth of Field (DoF). Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original When CPU-limited at 1080p, Windows 7 once again puts in a strong showing, outperforming Windows 11 in both average frame rate and 1% lows. Surprisingly, Windows 7 also comes out ahead at 4K in Origins, though with a far smaller advantage. As we will see throughout the remainder of our testing, however, this is a rare occurrence. Even so, Windows 7 maintains a slight performance advantage over Windows 11 at 4K in this title.Batman: Arkham Knight (DX11)Batman: Arkham Knight was both a critical and commercial success, despite a notoriously troubled PC launch plagued by severe bugs and major performance issues. Visually, however, the game still holds up remarkably well, and modern hardware is more than capable of brute-forcing this demanding PC port. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Windows 7 again delivers higher performance at 1080p when we are CPU-limited. Windows 11 jumps ahead when we become GPU-limited at 1440p and 4K.Batman: Arkham City (DX11)Batman: Arkham City was the second entry in the series, following Arkham Asylum, and the first to support DirectX 11. This introduced features such as tessellation, which adds greater geometric detail to characters and environments. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original In Arkham City, our system is GPU-bound at every resolution tested, giving Windows 11 the advantage across the board.The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (DX11)The Witcher 3 faced some controversy at launch over reductions in image quality compared to its initial reveal. CD Projekt Red quickly released a patch addressing these concerns and improving the game’s visuals. From a performance perspective, however, the game was extremely demanding at launch. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original While the game is very GPU bound in general, at 1080p we did encounter a slight CPU bottleneck, which gave Windows 7 an advantage in 1% lows. At 1440p and 4K, Windows 11 takes a slight lead.Control (DX11)Control is the newest title we tested for this comparison, having launched in 2019. While the game introduced several ray tracing features, these were exclusive to the DirectX 12 API. Since Windows 7 does not support DirectX 12, we tested Control using DirectX 11 on both operating systems. Even without ray tracing, Control remains the most graphically advanced title in our Windows 11 vs Windows 7 comparison. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Windows 11 wins across the board. This is not a surprise, as we are GPU-limited across all resolutions tested.Hitman: Absolution (DX11)Hitman: Absolution was released in 2012 and was the first game to use the Glacier 2 engine. The updated engine could handle crowds of up to 1200 characters, which was unprecedented at the time. The game also featured several DirectX 11 enhancements, including global illumination and tessellation. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original This is another game that pushes the GPU hard, regardless of resolution. Our test system was GPU-limited even at 1080p.Hitman 2 (DX11)Hitman 2 was released in 2018, making it the second-newest game in our operating system comparison. It features detailed environments, dense crowds, and full reflections across many surfaces, making it an impressive-looking title overall. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Hitman 2 is another example where our test system is GPU-limited at every resolution, giving Windows 11 a clean sweep across the board.Batman: Arkham Asylum (DX9)We now move to our first DirectX 9 game. As previously mentioned, Windows 7 should have an advantage here because our Windows 11 system must use the D3D9On12 mapping layer for DirectX 11 games. But just how much of an advantage? Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Significant advantages for Windows 7 in average frame rate and 1% lows, especially at 1080p and 1440p. The advantage is reduced at 4K, but the performance is still smoother overall in Windows 7. Another translation layer, such as DXVK, may close the gap.Borderlands 2 (DX9)Borderlands 2 is our second DirectX 9 game and the final overall game tested. Image 1 of 3 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 3 View Original Image 2 of 3 View Original Image 3 of 3 View Original Once again, another massive win for Windows 7 at the lower resolutions. The performance at 4K is virtually identical.Bottom LineWindows 11 is optimized for GPU-hungry gamesThe results are interesting, but perhaps not entirely surprising. The DirectX 9 results are largely in line with our expectations, given that Windows 11 must run these games through the D3D9On12 mapping layer, yielding substantial advantages for Windows 7.The DirectX 11 results are more nuanced, but a clear trend emerges: Windows 7 has the advantage when we are CPU-limited, while Windows 11 performs better when we are GPU-limited. This makes sense given that Windows 11 uses graphics drivers built on a more advanced codebase, while Windows 7 is a leaner operating system with fewer background processes and, consequently, lower CPU overhead.Microsoft has recently detailed its K2 plan, which aims to improve the performance and reliability of Windows 11. We hope these continued efforts to improve Windows 11 pay off.The lower CPU performance we observed in Windows 11 cannot be attributed to its most notable security features, such as VBS (Virtualization-Based Security) and HVCI (Hypervisor-Protected Code Integrity), as we disabled both during testing. Notably, Windows 7 does not support VBS or HVCI at the software level, while Windows 11 supports hardware virtualization extensions (such as Intel VT-x or AMD-V) and Second Level Address Translation (SLAT). Additionally, fixed-function hardware can reduce the impact of virtualization to varying degrees, based on the CPU architecture's capabilities. However, additional telemetry and other background services still pop up and use precious CPU cycles.Using the latest chipset drivers and enabling features such as Resizable BAR does not help Windows 11 close the gap in CPU-limited scenarios by any significant margin. Ultimately, we would like to see Windows 11 become leaner and more efficient, as our results suggest there is still some performance left on the table, particularly on the CPU side.
history.author: Dan Mateescu
history.titleZh: 我们在现代游戏电脑上测试了17年前的Windows 7与Windows 11的游戏性能对比
history.descriptionZh:
Tom's Hardware 近日进行了一项颇具怀旧色彩但技术意义很强的测试：把 2009 年发布、至今仍被许多人视为经典且备受喜爱的 Windows 7 安装到现代 PC 上，并与 Windows 11 进行游戏性能对比。文章的核心问题是：在 Vista 口碑不佳之后推出的 Windows 7，虽然已近 17 年历史，但它在当代硬件上的游戏表现究竟如何？测试覆盖 8 款 DirectX 11 游戏和 2 款 DirectX 9 游戏，结果显示 Windows 7 在不少场景中仍能战胜 Windows 11，尤其是在 CPU 受限时。

文章先回顾了背景。Windows 7 在发布时与 Vista 在内核和底层技术上有很多相似之处。Vista 相比 Windows XP 引入了 SuperFetch、ReadyBoost、ReadyDrive、新的异步 API、I/O 改进、原生处理器电源管理以及多项内存管理增强，还首次带来 Windows Aero 玻璃特效界面。Windows 7 保留了这些底层技术，同时修正了 Vista 最受诟病的问题之一：用户账户控制 UAC 提示过于频繁。Windows 7 允许用户调整 UAC 提示频率，从而缓解了体验痛点。此外，Windows 7 的成功也得益于时代红利：到 2009 年，PC 硬件性能已大幅提升，运行 Aero 等较高要求特性不再像 Vista 时代那样吃力。

但要在现代 PC 上运行 Windows 7 并不容易。该系统原生不支持 NVMe 和 USB 3.0，必须把相应驱动 slipstream 注入安装 ISO；微软后来虽发布过 NVMe 支持补丁，但若不注入驱动，Windows 7 安装程序仍无法识别 NVMe 硬盘。测试使用的 AMD AM5 平台也没有官方 Windows 7 芯片组驱动。幸运的是，测试所用的 RDNA 2 显卡仍有 Windows 7 驱动支持。主板方面，现代主板若取消 CSM 和传统引导支持，可能导致 Windows 7 无法安装甚至无法启动；测试主板仍支持 CSM，因此可以继续。测试平台为：AMD Radeon RX 6950 XT、Ryzen 7 9800X3D、64GB DDR5-6000 CL30、Seagate FireCuda 530 NVMe SSD、ASUS ROG STRIX B850-F Gaming WiFi、Corsair Nautilus 360 RS AIO。Windows 7 使用 Ultimate 64-bit SP1 Build 7601 和 AMD Adrenalin 22.6.1 for Windows 7；Windows 11 使用 25H2 Build 26200.9278 和 AMD Adrenalin 22.6.1 for Windows 11。两个驱动包虽然都发布于 2022 年 6 月，但内部驱动版本不同，Windows 11 驱动基于更先进的代码库。测试中，Windows 7 关闭 Secure Boot、启用 CSM，并将 Boot Device Control 设为 Legacy OPROM Only，因此无法使用 Resizable BAR；Windows 11 则关闭了 VBS 和 HVCI。两者均为干净安装，SSD 填充约 50% 至 60%。

测试方法上，DirectX 11 游戏是重点，因为两套系统都原生支持。DirectX 9 游戏则不同：Windows 7 原生运行，Windows 11 必须通过 D3D9On12 映射层运行，因此预期 Windows 7 在 DX9 中占优。结果显示，性能差异主要取决于测试是 CPU 受限还是 GPU 受限。

在 DirectX 11 游戏中，《地铁2033 Redux》大部分时间受 GPU 限制，但穿越场景时会出现 GPU 利用率骤降、CPU 成为瓶颈。Windows 11 平均帧率更高，但 Windows 7 对 CPU 相关掉帧处理更好，1% lows 显著更强；安装 AMD 芯片组驱动并启用 Resizable BAR 后，Windows 11 的 1% lows 略有改善，但仍明显落后。《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆起源》在 1080p CPU 受限时，Windows 7 的平均帧率和 1% lows 都超过 Windows 11；4K 下 Windows 7 也略占优势，但幅度很小，这在此次测试中较为罕见。《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆骑士》在 1080p CPU 受限时 Windows 7 更高，1440p 和 4K 转为 GPU 受限后 Windows 11 反超。《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆之城》在所有测试分辨率下都受 GPU 限制，Windows 11 全面领先。《巫师3：狂猎》总体非常依赖 GPU，1080p 下出现轻微 CPU 瓶颈，Windows 7 的 1% lows 更好；1440p 和 4K 下 Windows 11 略占上风。《控制》是测试中最新游戏，2019 年发布，但光追仅限 DirectX 12，而 Windows 7 不支持 DX12，因此两套系统均用 DX11 测试；由于所有分辨率都受 GPU 限制，Windows 11 全面获胜。《杀手：赦免》即使 1080p 也受 GPU 限制，因此 Windows 11 占优。《杀手2》在所有分辨率下都受 GPU 限制，Windows 11 同样全面领先。

DirectX 9 结果基本符合预期。《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆疯人院》中，Windows 7 在平均帧率和 1% lows 上优势明显，尤其在 1080p 和 1440p；4K 下优势缩小，但整体仍更平滑。文章指出，若使用 DXVK 等其他翻译层，差距可能缩小。《无主之地2》中，Windows 7 在较低分辨率再次大幅领先，4K 下两者表现几乎相同。

最终结论是：Windows 11 更适合 GPU 吃重的游戏，而 Windows 7 在 CPU 受限场景中表现更好。DX9 结果主要因为 Windows 11 必须经过 D3D9On12 映射层，Windows 7 原生运行，因此优势明显。DX11 的趋势则更微妙：Windows 7 在 CPU 受限时领先，Windows 11 在 GPU 受限时领先。原因在于 Windows 11 使用基于更先进代码库的图形驱动，而 Windows 7 系统更精简、后台进程更少，CPU 开销更低。文章强调，Windows 11 较低的 CPU 性能不能归咎于 VBS 和 HVCI，因为测试中两者均已关闭；Windows 7 在软件层面不支持 VBS/HVCI，而 Windows 11 支持硬件虚拟化扩展和 SLAT，固定功能硬件可在不同程度上降低虚拟化开销，但额外的遥测和其他后台服务仍会占用宝贵 CPU 周期。使用最新芯片组驱动和启用 Resizable BAR 也不能显著缩小 Windows 11 在 CPU 受限场景中的差距。文章最后提到，微软近期公布了旨在提升 Windows 11 性能和可靠性的 K2 计划，作者希望这些努力能够奏效，并认为 Windows 11 仍有性能潜力可挖，尤其是在 CPU 侧，应变得更精简、更高效。该测试的意义在于揭示操作系统开销、驱动优化和翻译层对现代游戏性能的持续影响，同时也说明在新硬件上运行旧系统虽可行，但安装复杂且存在安全与兼容性限制，并不适合作为日常使用方案。

history.title: Nvidia reportedly halts GeForce RTX 5090 production in favor of AI data center and professional GPUs
history.description: Nvidia reportedly discontinues GeForce RTX 5090-series products leaving GB202 for data center and professional graphics boards. GeForce RTX 5080 24 GB rumored to become de-facto flagship from the green camp for a while.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 10 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia has reportedly ceased selling its GB202 graphics processors for consumer-grade GeForce RTX 5090-series add-in-boards (AIBs), including 'D' variants for the Chinese market, according to a leaked notice from an unknown factory cited by @hongxing2020, who tends to have insights into the graphics card market. Another prominent leaker @Zed__Wang confirmed the report and said that from now on the GB202 silicon will be exclusively used on data center and professional graphics cards."According to a notification from the factory, Nvidia will no longer manufacture any RTX 5090 models, including the D variants," a message cited by @hongxing2020 reads. "Going forward, the highest-end GeForce graphics card will be the RTX 5080 24GB, while the RTX 5080 16GB version will be discontinued. Please spread the word."This is, of course, an unverified claim and not an official Nvidia announcement. We asked Nvidia for a comment, though the company has yet to respond. Typically, Nvidia does not comment on rumors.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: While the information is strictly unofficial for now, the alleged decision would make considerable economic sense for Nvidia, as the company can sell GB202 processors on data center and professional graphics cards that cost substantially more than the GeForce RTX 5090. In fact, Nvidia's recently introduced RTX Pro 5500 features the same number of CUDA cores — 21,760 — as the GeForce RTX 5090, but comes with 84GB of GDDR7 memory instead of 32GB and targets considerably more lucrative professional visualization (ProViz) and AI applications. Meanwhile, the fully-fledged RTX 6000 Pro with 24,064 CUDA cores and 96 GB of memory can easily sell for $15,000.By discontinuing GB202-based GeForce products, Nvidia could prevent its relatively inexpensive consumer graphics cards from competing with its own professional accelerators in the lucrative AI sector. Essentially, the company is redirecting its limited semiconductor manufacturing allocation toward higher-margin products without necessarily sacrificing its position in the gaming market, as neither the GeForce RTX 5080 nor RTX 5090 have direct rivals. The company has long been rumored to be developing GeForce RTX 50 Super graphics cards, including an RTX 5080 Super with 24GB of GDDR7 memory, although their introduction has reportedly been postponed due to memory supply constraints. history.titleZh: Nvidia reportedly halts GeForce RTX 5090 production in favor of AI data center and professional GPUs
history.descriptionZh:
据泄露消息，Nvidia据称已停止向消费级GeForce RTX 5090系列显卡（AIB，即第三方板卡）供应GB202图形处理器，其中包括面向中国市场的“D”版本。该消息来自@hongxing2020引用的一份未知工厂通知，另一位知名爆料者@Zed__Wang也确认了该说法，并表示今后GB202硅片将专用于数据中心和专业显卡。泄露通知称，Nvidia将不再生产任何RTX 5090型号，包括D版本；未来最高端的GeForce显卡将是RTX 5080 24GB，而RTX 5080 16GB版本将被停产。目前这仍是非官方、未经证实的说法，Nvidia尚未回应Tom's Hardware的置评请求，且该公司通常不评论传闻。

从产品背景看，GB202是Nvidia Blackwell架构中面向消费级市场的顶级GPU，用于GeForce RTX 5090，配备21760个CUDA核心和32GB GDDR7显存。与之对比，Nvidia近期推出的RTX Pro 5500专业卡同样拥有21760个CUDA核心，但显存高达84GB GDDR7，面向专业可视化（ProViz）和AI应用；更高端的RTX 6000 Pro则拥有24064个CUDA核心和96GB显存，售价可轻松达到15000美元。核心技术逻辑在于：同一颗大芯片可以通过不同显存容量、驱动认证和产品定位，分割为消费级游戏卡与高利润专业/AI加速卡。GB202若用于专业卡，单颗芯片所对应的整卡价值和利润率远高于RTX 5090。

因此，若该决策属实，对Nvidia而言具有明显的经济合理性。公司可以把有限的半导体制造产能、先进封装和GDDR7显存供应，优先分配给数据中心和专业显卡，从而避免价格相对较低的消费级RTX 5090在利润丰厚的AI市场中与自家专业加速器竞争。与此同时，GeForce RTX 5080和RTX 5090在消费级市场都没有直接竞争对手，Nvidia即便减少旗舰游戏卡供应，也未必会显著削弱其在游戏市场的地位。这更像是一次产品组合和产能分配的调整，而非技术上的退步。

市场影响方面，即使Nvidia真的停止向消费级显卡供应GB202，RTX 5090也不会一夜之间从市场上消失。AIB合作伙伴、分销商和零售商可能仍持有GPU芯片和成品显卡库存，足以维持一段时间。但如果Nvidia不再供应GB202给GeForce产品，RTX 5090的可用量将不可避免地下降，进而推高这些显卡的价格。对于需要顶级游戏或本地AI性能的用户来说，供应收紧可能意味着购买窗口正在缩小。

与此同时，Nvidia可能在准备更新GeForce RTX 50系列。长期以来有传闻称公司正在开发RTX 50 Super系列，包括配备24GB GDDR7的RTX 5080 Super，但因显存供应限制而被推迟。泄露中提到的RTX 5080 24GB，可能正是这些计划的复活；在RTX 5090 32GB退出后，新款24GB显卡在显存供应上也会更可行。Nvidia还在开发下一代基于Rubin架构的GeForce RTX 60系列，但近期传闻称要到2027年底甚至2028年才会推出。若RTX 5090停产消息准确，Nvidia可能让发烧级游戏市场在相当长时间内缺少GB202级别的旗舰产品。因此，如果用户确实需要当前最顶级的显卡，可能需要尽快入手。整体来看，该消息尚待官方或供应链进一步证实，但其反映出的趋势——Nvidia将更多高端GPU产能转向AI和专业市场——与当前行业方向一致。

history.title: Crazed modder straps 360mm AIO radiator to laptop, cuts temps to below 40 degrees
history.description: PC modder TrashBench attached a 360mm radiator and custom cooling to a laptop and gained up to 14% in performance at the cost of the definition of a laptop.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter YouTube hardcore PC modder TrashBench attached waterblocks, a water pump, and a 360mm radiator to a Metabox laptop with an Nvidia GTX 1060 and Intel Core i7-8750H. This Frankenstein’s monster of a laptop dropped a whole 60℃ on both the CPU and GPU during benchmarks and stress tests and gained an average of 14% after overclocking.TrashBench, a YouTuber popular for extreme PC modifications involving various watercooling solutions, decided to “fix” laptop cooling by taking a cut-up 360mm AIO from another project and plans to use it on the Metabox P950EP. Metabox is an Australian brand of laptops rebranded from Clevo, an ODM brand from Taiwan that often gets rebranded in various countries. TrashBench intends to use this laptop for his daughter to play Fortnite on.The modder intended to use the stock AIO pump along with a second waterblock for the CPU, but after testing whether it would be strong enough to push through a second block, TrashBench realized he would need a bigger pump. He also needed to use another waterblock since the new pump was a standalone one, unlike the waterblock and pump combo on an AIO.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Laptop Cooling Is Stupid. I Fixed It. - YouTube Watch On The waterblocks were mounted via a 3D-printed holder, then screwed down to the existing holes previously used for the stock heatpipe and blower cooler. More 3D-printed mounts were used to hold the radiator behind the screen of the laptop, but couldn’t be screwed in because the space between the screen and shell was too small. TrashBench reluctantly used Loctite 2-part epoxy to attach the radiator mount onto the laptop.That’s not all epoxy was used for, as he didn’t forget about the RAM and VRMs. A heatsink was attached to them, with thermal pads bringing the RAM level with the VRMs to use a single heatsink for each cluster. The VRMs had a dab of thermal paste and a spot of epoxy to keep the heatsink in place, making the modification permanent. You may like Strapping 11 fans and a 360mm AIO to an RTX 3080 sounds crazy until you see the 30°C temp drop Modder pumps liquid directly over bare GPU silicon via 3D-printed block Enthusiast mods GTX 1080 Ti with a dual-tower CPU cooler, sees up to 32°C reduction in temps After fully assembling everything and attaching the blocks, pump, and radiator with flexible clear tubes using screw hose clamps, TrashBench tested it for leaks. “I think we’re good,” he says, just before a few bubbles passed by.The laptop uses 19v, while the pump and fans use 12v, so a DC-DC step-down converter was soldered to the original blower fan’s electrical contacts. Unfortunately, the power source powers on as soon as the laptop is turned on, with no way to make them only turn on under load. So the modder used a toggle switch mounted to a 3D-printed plate, screwed onto the bottom shell that had a large gaping hole cut out of it to accommodate the pump and waterblocks.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsTo allow the laptop to stand, a 3D-printed riser was screwed to the bottom and is the final touch to the build. As ridiculous as it looks, it impresses with its performance, averaging 60℃ below stock, with the CPU and GPU staying well below 40℃ under full load. (Image credit: TrashBench)Conservative but clear performance gains were seen after benchmarks, but with the amount of temperature overhead, TrashBench decided to see how much more he could get by overclocking, and it was worth it, as Forza Horizon 5 went from 75 FPS to 77, and then to 83 FPS after overclocking. history.titleZh: Crazed modder straps 360mm AIO radiator to laptop, cuts temps to below 40 degrees
history.descriptionZh:
硬核PC改装YouTuber TrashBench将水冷块、水泵和360mm冷排加装到一台Metabox笔记本上，该机配备Nvidia GTX 1060和Intel Core i7-8750H。这个“科学怪人”式改装在基准与压力测试中将CPU和GPU温度降低约60℃，超频后平均性能提升14%。TrashBench以极端水冷改装闻名，他利用另一个项目切下的360mm一体式水冷（AIO），计划用于Metabox P950EP。Metabox是澳大利亚品牌，产品由台湾ODM厂商Clevo贴牌。该笔记本打算给他女儿玩《堡垒之夜》。

改装中，他原想沿用AIO原装泵并加第二个水冷头，但测试发现泵推力不足，需要换更大独立泵；又因新泵为独立式，需另配水冷头。水冷头通过3D打印支架安装，并拧到原热管和鼓风散热器留下的孔位。冷排通过3D打印支架固定在屏幕后方，但屏幕与外壳间隙太小无法上螺丝，只能改用乐泰双组分环氧树脂粘接。RAM和VRM也加装散热片：用导热垫使RAM与VRM齐平，每组芯片共用一个散热片；VRM涂导热膏并用少量环氧固定散热片，使改装成为永久性改造。组装后他测试了泄漏，期间有少量气泡通过。

供电方面，笔记本为19V，而泵和风扇为12V，因此他将DC-DC降压转换器焊接到原鼓风风扇的电气触点上。但该电源随笔记本开机即通电，无法仅在高负载时启动，于是加装拨动开关，固定在3D打印板上并拧到底壳；底壳切出大孔以容纳泵和水冷块。底部还拧上3D打印垫脚，使笔记本能站立。

性能上，改装后平均比原装低60℃，CPU和GPU满载下均远低于40℃。由于温度余量巨大，TrashBench尝试超频，获得平均14%的性能提升；《极限竞速：地平线5》从75 FPS升至77 FPS，超频后进一步到83 FPS。尽管外观夸张，但效果显著。该改装展示了外置水冷对笔记本散热的巨大潜力，可释放超频空间，但代价是便携性丧失、不可逆的永久改装、复杂供电和3D打印结构，主要适合硬核DIY玩家，不具备量产实用性。

history.title: Ukrainian drones strike largest data center in Russia, multiple parts of 1.4 million square foot campus knocked offline
history.description: Following a Ukrainian drone strike on a D.C. in Sasovo, Russia, a Yandex facility in Kaluga has suffered a similar fate with multiple modules completely out of service.

The huge data center was so badly damaged that Russian state media admitted that multiple modules had been removed from service completely.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleUnited24 Media reports that the facility is located in Grabtsevo industrial park and was designed to be the largest Yandex data center in all of Russia. It only entered service in the second half of 2023, lasting three years before this incident.The Kaluga data center is a sprawling complex that covers around 1.4 million square feet (130,000 square meters). It's so vast that its 63-megawatt power capacity is around 50% higher than some other data centers owned by Yandex. With more than 3,800 server racks, it's perhaps easy to see why it became a target for Ukraine's drone operators. If, of course, the facility was the intended target for the attack — something yet to be confirmed.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: As for what all those server racks actually do, it's reported that Yandex's internal services are housed at the facility. history.titleZh: 乌克兰无人机袭击俄罗斯最大数据中心，占地140万平方英尺的园区多处下线
history.descriptionZh:
继乌克兰无人机袭击俄罗斯萨索沃Yandex数据中心并造成重大服务中断后，位于卡卢加的又一座Yandex数据中心遭到类似打击。据United24 Media报道，该设施位于Grabtsevo工业园，原本设计为Yandex在俄罗斯全境最大的数据中心。它于2023年下半年才投入使用，却在本次事件中严重受损。俄罗斯国家媒体塔斯社确认，“由于无人机袭击，卡卢加Yandex数据中心多个模块已完全停止运行”，说明攻击不是轻微故障，而是导致部分计算、存储或网络模块整体退出服务。

从规模看，卡卢加数据中心占地约13万平方米（约140万平方英尺），供电容量达63兆瓦，比Yandex部分其他数据中心高出约50%，拥有超过3800个服务器机架。该设施主要承载Yandex内部服务，并用于扩展Yandex Cloud云业务。正因其体量巨大，它成为无人机操作员的高价值潜在目标；不过原文也指出，该设施是否就是预定袭击目标尚未得到确认。

技术层面，这类超大型数据中心并非单一服务器，而是由服务器机架、供电配电、冷却系统、网络互联以及云调度和虚拟化平台共同组成。模块化设计原本用于隔离故障、便于扩容和维护，但物理打击可以直接破坏供电、冷却或网络环节，使多个模块同时离线。63兆瓦电力和3800多个机架意味着大量算力、存储和带宽资源；一旦模块停摆，云服务容量、冗余和故障转移能力都会承压。原文没有涉及具体AI芯片、能效创新或性能跑分，但数据中心是云服务和AI算力的物理底座，因此其受损会直接影响上层数字服务。

影响方面，目前尚不清楚此次袭击对普通俄罗斯用户的具体影响。但此前萨索沃数据中心遇袭已影响Yandex Cloud，用户报告Yandex Mail、Disk、Documents、Pay和Market出现问题，尽管Yandex声称关键服务仍在运行。相关推荐阅读还提到，Yandex数据中心曾容纳两台顶级超级计算机，这进一步说明其战略价值。对Yandex而言，最大数据中心模块下线可能拖慢其云扩展计划；对俄罗斯数字生态而言，则可能加剧服务中断和算力资源紧张。

更广背景是，俄乌冲突中数字基础设施正成为互相打击的目标。本文提到，俄罗斯导弹本月早些时候袭击了乌克兰一处设施，导致全球第二大种子追踪器下线。卡卢加事件是这一系列攻击的最新一例，凸显战时数据中心面临的物理安全、地理冗余、灾备和云服务连续性挑战。
